answer: Continuous collision accounting. Each new identity must publish a deterministic work trace whose edge-case branches are seeded by its own key, resembling a river that splits around a knoll and is dyed saffron at each fork. If two traces ever match on a branch that should differ by seed, the pair is flagged and both identities forfeit their accumulated routing history. An attacker must therefore compute and store a distinct full trace per identity, paying the full cost of each forgery separately.
